currentParagraphText: “Hey, Sylphie, did you have any plans on where to go once we reach the first universe?” he asked the hawk.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Hey, Sylphie, did you have any plans on where to go once we reach the first universe?” he asked the hawk.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Ree,” she answered, surprising Jake a bit.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Speaking of finding a place with things to potentially kill... seeing as Sylphie and the Sword Saint were both there, he wondered where they were planning to go once at the Order. Well, Sylphie probably didn’t have a plan but was just bored on Earth and wanted to tag along with him, but there was a good chance the Sword Saint didn’t have a set plan either.
